title: Pomerangen-Liqueur (Orange Liqueur)
description: Prepared with brandy, oranges, and sugar.
steps: Rub the peel of one orange on sugar
Add the whole other orange to the brandy
Add three-quarter pound sugar to half Maß brandy
Bind the glass well and stir twice daily
On the twenty-first day, filter, fill into bottles, cork well, and let stand for 6 to 7 months

title: Pomersche geräucherte Gans (Pomeranian Smoked Goose)
description: Prepared with goose, saltpeter, and salt.
steps: Fatten the goose very well, especially from the time it begins to lay on its keel
Provide oats, grain, bran, carrots and parsnips; give it as much movement as possible
Feed it clean good feed at night and provide fresh clean water, sometimes also river water
Pluck the goose only gently, taking only as many feathers as naturally come away in the hand
By Martinmas you will see a very different goose than usual
After slaughter and removing the entrails and everything, dissolve the bones
Rub the goose inside with salt, saltpeter, cloves and pepper
Rub it outside with salt
Fold the two halves of the goose with the inside facing each other, tie with twine, and press slightly between two boards placed at an angle in a dish
Baste the goose alternately with drippings, today on one side, tomorrow on the other
After ten days in the drippings, once it has dried a little, wrap in paper and bring into weak smoke
Cut into slices like salmon

title: Pommes Duchesses (Duchess Potatoes)
description: Prepared with potatoes, egg yolks, and butter.

ingredients.name: ½ kg cooked, passed, cooled potatoes
ingredients.sourceText: ½ kg cooked, passed, cooled potatoes

Press a grid pattern into the top with a knife.
Brush with beaten egg.
Place on a buttered, floured baking sheet and bake at moderately high heat until light brown.
Keep warm until serving.

title: Pommes à la Polonaise (Apples Polish Style)
description: Prepared with bread crumbs, bread, and chestnuts.

ingredients.name: Bread crumbs, black (1 heaped tablespoon, grated)
ingredients.sourceText: Bread crumbs, black (1 heaped tablespoon, grated)

steps: In a casserole containing melted butter, add a heaped tablespoon of grated black bread, 16 drams of Périgueux, 1 crushed clove, 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon and equally finely grated lemon peel
Mix well together and let it brown, then set aside to cool
When cooled, line a butter-coated casserole, lined with pastry, with a layer of the roasted bread mixture
On this place peeled roasted chestnuts, sprinkle again with bread and cover with apple sauce mixed with currants and raisins
Give another layer of roasted bread and continue until the casserole is filled
The last layer should be roasted bread, which is then pressed down firmly with a spoon
Bake for 1/2 hour in the oven

title: Poppy Seed Strudel von Germteig (Poppy Seed Yeast Strudel)
description: Prepared with yeast, filling, and milk.
steps: Prepare the yeast dough from recipe 1253 and let it rise
Roll out the risen dough on a flour-dusted board to the thickness of a knife back
Prepare filling: stir finely pounded poppy seed into boiling milk and cook with sugar
Add raisins as desired to the filling
Spread the filling on the dough

Roll up the dough completely, place on a butter-greased baking sheet
Cover and let rise in a warm place
Brush the strudel strongly with beaten egg and bake in the oven

title: Pork Kidneys in Champagne Wine (Schweinsnieren in Champagner Wein)
description: Prepared with pork kidneys, shallots, and wine.
steps: Slice the kidneys thinly and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and a little nutmeg.
Cook them in butter with finely chopped shallots and parsley for a while over high heat until the kidneys begin to stiffen.
Dust them with a little flour and pour in a glass of champagne wine.
Turn them frequently so they do not stick, but they must not boil.
Arrange croutons on a plate and serve the kidneys hot.

title: Potato and Egg Casserole (Appetizer Dish)
description: Prepared with potatoes, capers, and bread crumbs.
steps: Peel the boiled potatoes and cut them into thin slices, mixing them well with {{source-1}} and some salt.
Butter the bottom of a casserole dish (which can also be brought to table) and dust it with flour.
Layer the cut potatoes, then sprinkle with hard-boiled eggs cut into slices and peeled capers finely diced.
Beat 1/2 liter of milk cream with 3 whole eggs and pour some spoonfuls over the eggs and capers.
Add another layer of potatoes, sprinkle with eggs and capers, and continue until the casserole is full.
If potatoes are the last layer, pour the remaining cream over them, sprinkle with bread crumbs, and bake in the oven for 3/4 to 1 hour, covered at first so the crumbs do not burn.
When the egg mixture shows no more liquid, remove from oven and serve at table in the casserole, or turn out into a dish earlier.

Alternatively, the whole dish can be made in a buttered bowl and baked in the oven, or lined in a buttered torte form with knife-thick layer of butter dough, filled with potatoes as described above, and baked in the oven. Before serving, remove the rim so the egg dish comes to table in the crust.

title: Potato Casserole (Timbale de pommes de terre)
description: Prepared with potatoes, short pastry, and ham.
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into pieces, and pour boiling salt water over them (only enough so the water goes 1/2 finger width above the potatoes), add 10 ounces of butter and cook them soft until they can be stirred into a puree, then stir in another 10 ounces of butter, salt, and some pepper.
Lightly brush the bottom and sides of a casserole or desired form with butter and line with short pastry dough. This can be rolled the thickness of a cord and arranged in the form of a spiral.

Put the stirred potatoes 1/2 finger high on the bottom of the form, cover them with smoked ham that has been cooked soft and cut into small pieces, fried sausages, or fried goose liver, add again as much potato as before, and continue until the casserole is full.
Then cover the opening with dough and bake the cake for about 1 hour at moderate heat.

title: Potato Dumplings (Noques de pommes de terre)
description: Prepared with potatoes, bread crumbs, and lard.
steps: Roast the potatoes in glowing ashes or in the oven, pass them through a sieve, and then stir in 8 ounces of butter and 3 whole eggs, to which add also salt, some nutmeg, and finely cut parsley.

Pass this mixture through and let it cool. When the whole thing is cold and firm, form quenelles with a spoon, roll them in eggs and bread crumbs, bake them in hot lard and serve immediately. This is used as a garnish for roast beef and for various meat dishes.

title: Potato Noodles (Erdäpfel-Nüdeln)
description: Prepared with potatoes, egg, and flour.
steps: Cook potatoes until soft, peel them, and pass through a sieve
After cooling completely, place on a board
Work into a smooth but not too soft dough with 1 whole egg, necessary flour, and {{source-3}}
Roll the dough on a floured board into thumb-thick ropes
Cut into finger-width pieces and form each into small finger-thick noodles with pointed or blunt ends
Add to boiling salted water and cook covered for 10 to 15 minutes
Drain in a colander and rinse with cold water
Toast 8 tablespoons of breadcrumbs or semolina in 16 tablespoons of hot butter
Add the drained potato noodles, season to taste, stir well
When hot, arrange in a platter using a spoon and serve

title: Potato Soup (Consis de pommes de terre)
description: Prepared with butter or fat, onion, and potatoes.
steps: Toast the onion and green parsley in butter
Add flour as needed and toast until slightly yellow
Gradually add 2 liters of cold water while stirring to prevent lumps
Bring to a boil
Add diced raw potatoes, marjoram, and salt

title: Poularde Pâté (Chicken Pâté)
description: Prepared with hen, truffles, and veal.
steps: Cut the poularde along the back and lay it open; carefully pull out the bones while leaving the flesh attached to the skin.

Sprinkle the poularde with salt and pepper, lay small truffles upon it, spread with veal farce, add another layer of truffles, spread again with farce, and continue until the poularde is completely filled and has regained its natural form.
Prepare the butter dough and form the pâté as described in the 'Goose Liver Pâté' recipe (No. 1057).
Line the inside of the pâté with thin slices of bacon.
Spread the bottom 2 fingers high with veal farce, sprinkle with finely diced truffles, and place the poularde with its back upon it.

Spread the poularde with veal farce, fill the pâté with cut truffles and chopped goose liver, spread again with veal farce, and cover with a slice of bacon that has been scored several times beforehand.
Proceed as described in the 'Goose Liver Pâté' recipe.
Bake for 1½ to 2 hours.
Use ⅕ kilo of veal farce for the poularde and for filling the pâté.

title: Pressw urst (Pressed Sausage)
description: Prepared with ham, bacon, and pork.
steps: Cut the 1 pound ham, 1 pound bacon, 2 pounds pork, and pork ears uncooked into small diced and oblong pieces
Add several finely cut onions and a couple pieces of finely cut garlic
Season well with salt and pepper, and mix well with basil and thyme
Fill this mixture into a pig's stomach and tie it well on both sides

Add several bay leaves and cloves to the liquid
Let it cook for a full 2 hours in this broth
Remove the stomach and place it between two bowls so it is compressed somewhat
Let the broth congeal into jelly, and when the stomach has cooled well, slice it and pour the jelly over it

title: Pudding von Hecht, gebacken (Baked Pike Pudding)
description: A pudding made with pike, crayfish, and bread crumbs.
steps: Cook a pike of several pounds in salted water
Remove the bones from the flesh and shred it finely
Add finely cut meat from 50 cooked and shelled crayfish
Make crayfish butter, reserving as much as needed for the sauce after it cools
Toast 1 pound grated bread crumbs in the remaining crayfish butter
Fill it with 1 Maß milk and 1/2 Maß cream
Let it cook to a moderately stiff consistency
Season this batter, once cooled in a bowl, with salt and nutmeg
After a quarter hour, stir in finely chopped anchovies, 12 egg yolks, finely chopped pike and crayfish flesh, and lastly the whites of 12 eggs beaten to snow
Line a mold or casserole with good butter dough, fill in the mass, and bake for 1.5 hours
Serve with crayfish sauce, using the remaining crayfish butter

Serve with a wine foam when serving.

title: Pudding à la Rodney
description: A pudding made with egg yolks, egg whites, and butter.

steps: Heat half a pound of butter, seven pounds of sugar, and one seidel of milk in a casserole
Stir in {{source-3}} until the dough is stiff
Let it cool
Stir in one pound more of sugar, 16 egg yolks, and some salt
Continue stirring for a while
Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold in so nothing is visible
Bind the pudding in a napkin that has been soaked in water for an hour
Cook in water salted with meat broth for the appropriate time
For the sauce: Set one pound of washed sago with finely cut lemon zest on the heat
When it begins to boil and becomes somewhat clear, pour in one seidel of red wine
Add as much sugar as needed, lemon slices, several spoonfuls of currant jelly, and some whole cinnamon
Let the broth cook until the sago is fully swollen
Pour this sauce over the pudding when serving

When this is done, cover the biscuit with boiling hot jam

title: Punſchkrapfen (Punch Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolks, breadcrumbs, and egg whites.
steps: Beat 15 dkg sugar with 6 egg yolks for 30 minutes
Stir in 1 spoon fine breadcrumbs
Fold in 6 stiff egg whites with 15 dkg soaked grated almonds
Spread half the mass onto a buttered, floured baking sheet, not too thin
Bake until light brown
Immediately cut with a small pastry cutter
Mix 7 dkg grated chocolate into the other half and proceed the same way
Spread a dark layer quite thickly with filling
Place a light layer on top
Put the pastry in the cutter
Press down evenly with a matching weight so the edge becomes nice and smooth
Ice them with red glaze

Pound them very finely with a little water

title: Quince Marmalade (Marmelade von Quitten)
description: Prepared with quinces, juice, and sugar.

ingredients.name: sugar (1 pound sugar per pound of quince pulp)
ingredients.sourceText: sugar (1 pound sugar per pound of quince pulp)

steps: Peel the quinces, cut them into four parts, and remove the cores.
Place in a pan with plenty of water on charcoal fire.
Cook until completely soft.
Pour off and press the pulp through a sieve.
Weigh the sugar: one pound of sugar per pound of quince pulp.
Clarify and cook all the sugar.
Stir the quince pulp into the sugar.
Add the juice of 2 lemons while cooking.
Keep on charcoal fire until thick, stirring to prevent burning.
Allow to cool before storing in jars or containers.

title: Quitten-Liqueur (Quince Liqueur)
description: Prepared with quince, quinces, and brandy.

ingredients.name: sugar per half of juice
ingredients.sourceText: 1 pound sugar per half of juice

steps: Take the largest and finest quinces
Peel them and remove the core house
Crush them in a large mortar
Press through a strong cloth
For 1 Maß brandy take 3 halves quince juice, and for each half take 1 pound sugar
Place everything together in a large glass, cover well
Let stand for 12 days
On the thirteenth day, filter through filter paper
Fill into bottles, cork well, and let stand for 6 months

description: A fruit preserve made with quince, quince or apples or pears, and water.

ingredients.sourceText: Quince, peeled and rubbed with lemon juice

One can also let some pieces of orange blossoms steep with it

title: Ragout of Veal (Ragout von Kalbfleiſch)
description: Prepared with veal, broth, and cream.

ingredients.name: a piece of cold roasted veal
ingredients.sourceText: a piece of cold roasted veal

steps: Take a piece of cold roasted veal, cut it into large cubes, and make a butter sauce: let a piece of butter the size of an egg become warm, add a spoonful of flour, let it brown slightly, fill it with broth, add a spoonful of cream and some ground pepper.

Once the sauce is ready, add the veal pieces, also 25 to 30 pieces of asparagus and mushrooms, which should first be braised in butter and green parsley; let everything braise together well until no sauce remains.

Arrange it in a dish in the shape of a mountain, and place a wreath of puff pastry around it. If asparagus is no longer available, cauliflower may be used instead, which should first be boiled in salt water and cut into pieces.

description: A salad made with bream, endive, and broth.
steps: Cut the sea bream lengthwise in half, wash them well, then brown them in a casserole, add salt, pepper, and finely chopped fresh parsley, let them simmer in pea broth until they become thick, then stir in a couple of egg yolks.
Meanwhile cook well-cleaned endive salad in pea broth seasoned with cloves, nutmeg, a couple of bay leaves, green parsley, salt, and finely cut onions.
When it is tender enough, remove it and let it drain.
Beat five or six eggs, dip the salad well into them, sprinkle it with breadcrumbs, fry it in hot, only lightly salted lard, and garnish the ragout with it.

title: Ragout von Repphühnern, in Breslauer Paſtetchen (Partridge Ragout in Breslau Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with puff pastry, breadcrumbs, and bread.
steps: For the pastries, make a good puff pastry and roll it out.
Grease small pastry forms two fingers high with butter and sprinkle them with breadcrumbs; line them with this dough and place a piece of bread crumb paste cut into squares in the middle.

The lid is rolled out somewhat thicker than the bottom, and after being brushed with egg, is placed over the pastries, the excess cleanly cut off so the dough can rise high, and bake the pastries quickly.
For the ragout, roast two partridges, remove the breast meat and cut into small pieces, but pound the rest.
Set this on with some butter, a piece of ham cut into cubes, finely chopped shallots, coriander, some whole cloves, anise and peppercorns.
Sweat for a quarter hour, pour in half a pint of good wine, and let everything cook through well.
Then add some meat broth and let it cook again.

Strain the sauce through a hair sieve, place the finely cut partridges in it, and fill the pastries piping hot: namely remove the lids, remove the bread crumb paste, fill with as much filling as needed, then cover them again and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Ragout von Schildkröten (Turtle Ragout)
description: Prepared with turtle, green peas, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: Half a Seidel of young green peas
ingredients.sourceText: Half a Seidel of young green peas

steps: Boil the turtles in salt water until soft, break the shells in two parts, remove the cooked turtles, peel off the black skin from the feet and other parts, and carefully remove the entrails and liver so the gall does not burst.
Cut the turtles into four parts, make a small butter sauce, and fill it with pea water.
Take a piece of butter, some green parsley, half a Seidel of young green peas, twelve finely chopped mushrooms, fifteen to twenty crayfish tails, and let them braise.
When everything is well braised, add it to the turtles and let everything cook well together.
It should have only a little sauce when it is served at table.

title: Ragout von Tauben (Ragout de pigeons aux marrons)
description: Prepared with pigeons, liver, and broth.

ingredients.name: 4 plucked, scalded, washed, and salted pigeons
ingredients.sourceText: 4 plucked, scalded, washed, and salted pigeons

steps: Fill the pigeons with liver forcemeat, dress them, and place in a casserole containing 10 deca of butter.
Let them braise covered slowly for approximately 1 1/2 hours.
Remove the pigeons and place in another casserole.
Dust the butter remaining in the first casserole with flour, roast it, add white broth, stir well, and simmer.
Pour the sauce through a sieve over the pigeons and braise covered until they are tender.
1/4 hour before they are completely tender, add 16 deca of smoked sausage to the pigeons.
Meanwhile, keep 30 roasted, peeled chestnuts warm with 4 deca of sugar in the same amount of butter.
Cut the pigeons into 4 pieces, arrange on a platter, garnish with chestnuts, 20 small onions braised in butter until white and tender, and 10 boiled, dressed mushrooms, and serve with the sauce.

title: Red Sugar
description: Prepared with sugar and juice or cochineal.

ingredients.name: alkermes juice or dissolved cochineal dye
ingredients.sourceText: alkermes juice or dissolved cochineal dye

steps: Place the necessary hail sugar on a plate, moisten it with a few drops of alkermes juice or dissolved cochineal dye (both are obtainable at the pharmacy), and mix this with a metal spoon back and forth until the sugar has taken on an evenly beautiful red color and is completely dry. If one wants it darker, one must color it again after drying. The moistening must, however, always be done only in small measure, because too much moisture could dissolve the sugar; if time is pressing, one can also let the colored sugar dry in the oven, though it is better to do this in the air. Not only hail sugar but also the very fine sugar is colored in this way, only one must, after it has dried, pound and sieve it again. When the sugar is completely dry, it is stored in a glass jar.

title: Reis (Rice)

steps: Place the selected rice in a casserole with cold water (1 bowl rice to 1½ bowls water), 5 dkg butter or fat, optionally an onion studded with cloves, and salt.

If after this time it is not yet soft, pour in a little hot water and let it finish steaming.
If serving in a mold, rinse the mold first with hot water, press the rice in and turn it out.
Garnish the center with curled parsley.

title: Reis mit Vanillecreme (Rice with Vanilla Cream)
description: Prepared with rice, vanilla, and cream.
steps: Cook 16 Deca washed rice in {{source-1}} until very thick and set aside covered.
Beat 8 egg yolks, {{source-3}}, and 24 Deca finely pounded vanilla sugar together in a saucepan over heat, stirring until it begins to thicken, but do not allow to boil.
Press this mixture through a sieve into the rice and stir well together so that each grain of rice is separate, then place the rice on the stove.
Dissolve 2 Deca gelatin with {{source-6}} in a saucepan over heat, stirring until completely dissolved and steaming hot, but do not allow to boil.
Add the dissolved gelatin together with the rice in a saucepan and stir both over low heat until well mixed, but do not allow to boil.
Transfer this mass to a deep bowl and stir until it cools.
Once cooled, whip {{source-7}} to stiff peaks.
When the prepared cream feels lukewarm, fold the whipped cream in as quickly as possible until completely mixed.
Immediately transfer into a mold brushed with fine oil, which has been buried in ice 1 hour earlier.
Cover the mold with a plate and place a cloth over it.
After approximately 2 hours the cream will be sufficiently set.
Remove the mold from the ice, wipe it, press the cream away from the sides of the mold with your fingers, and turn the cream out onto a flat plate.
If it does not turn out easily, dip the mold briefly in hot water, wipe it dry, and turn out.
If the cream does not look quite beautiful with visible oil, quickly wipe it with a clean cloth.
Garnish with meringues, Spanish canes, small pastries, or fruit cooked in sugar.

Grease the mold or ring well with butter and sprinkle it with finely grated roll crumbs.

title: Ribisel-Marmelade (Currant Preserves)
description: A fruit preserve made with currants and powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: powdered sugar equal in weight to the currant juice
ingredients.sourceText: powdered sugar equal in weight to the currant juice

steps: Pass any quantity of currants through a very clean sieve without first cutting them, working quickly.
Place the empty sieve on the scale, weigh it, then fill with the juice from the passed currants and add powdered sugar by weight equal to the juice (for 1 kilogram juice, 1 kilogram powdered sugar).
Place this mixture immediately on heat and cook while stirring constantly for 15 minutes.
While still hot, fill into jars the same way as the Apricot Preserves.
Be very careful that the beautiful red color is not lost through overcooking.
If you want the preserves to be even more beautiful and fine, add 1.25 kilograms of sugar for 1 kilogram of juice.
Note that the preserves do not thicken while cooking but only gain consistency when they cool in the jars.
If white currant preserves have also been made, you can fill the jars with both types, red and white currants, in alternating layers, but you must always let one layer set before adding the next.

title: Rindfleiſch mit Paradeisſauce und Reis (Beef with Tomato Sauce and Rice)
description: A sauce made with beef, rice, and bones.

ingredients.name: 4 h soup greens (parsley root, yellow turnip, celery, leek)
ingredients.sourceText: 4 h soup greens (parsley root, yellow turnip, celery, leek)

steps: Prepare the broth: Beat the meat, rinse it thoroughly along with the bones and liver in cold water. Place all in cold water to start. If desiring good, juicy meat, place it in boiling water to quickly close the pores so the protein does not cook out. For 1 kg meat take 2½-3 liters water. If placing meat in cold water, the broth will be better. Do not skim off the foam that forms when boiling—this is the protein, the nutrient. After boiling, add 1-2 spoonfuls of salt, after a few minutes add the cleaned, washed and cut greens, a piece of cabbage, 1 onion ring roasted in a small pan in some fat until dark yellow, several mushrooms (fresh or dried), 5 spice grains, some ground pepper and caraway. Let the broth cook slowly for 2-2½ hours. It should only boil on one side and must not be stirred. To clarify it, add some clean eggshells during cooking and if it boils too vigorously, add a spoonful of cold water. Strain it through a fine sieve or napkin.

Prepare the tomato sauce: Wash the tomatoes, remove the stems, divide them, and stew for 30 minutes with very little water, salt, vinegar, 1 bay leaf, 5 pepper and spice grains, 2 cloves, and ½ onion in a pot. Pass them through a sieve, add to a light roux made from 4 dkg fat, pour on broth or water, cook for 15-20 minutes, sweeten to taste and optionally sour with red wine.
Prepare the rice: Select the rice carefully and place in a pot with cold water to cook.

title: Riſolen mit Hirn (Fried Pastry Pockets with Brain)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolk, flour, and butter.
steps: Rub together 16 decagrams flour with 4 decagrams butter
Add 1 egg yolk, a pinch of salt, and 1 spoonful milk; knead into dough
Let rest, then roll out thinly
Cut out rounds
Place filling in the center of each round
Brush the edges with egg white
Press the dough together over the filling
Place on an unfloured baking sheet
Fry in hot lard until golden
Drain and serve warm with cooked lettuce or spinach

For the filling: Wash the brain, remove the membrane, blanch it. In 3 decagrams hot butter, let chopped parsley begin to brown, add the brain, season with salt and pepper, let it stew for a few minutes while stirring. When cooled, fill the pastries. If the brain is too thin, thicken it with flour.
Serve on a flat plate on parchment paper, garnished with parsley

title: Riſotto (Risotto)
description: Prepared with rice, beef marrow, and meat or chicken or goose.

ingredients.name: cooked meat from 1 chicken or 1 goose
ingredients.sourceText: cooked meat from 1 chicken or 1 goose

steps: In 10 decagrams hot lard in a casserole, let 1 spring onion and the beef marrow begin to brown
Strain through a sieve and return the fat without the onion to the casserole
Add the cleaned rice and let it hiss for 3-4 minutes, but no longer
Pour in strained chicken broth so that it covers the rice by a finger's width
Stir and let the broth evaporate
Add salt and tomato paste, pour in more broth, and let the rice stew for approximately 30-45 minutes
Just before serving, add the grated cheese, the separately cooked peas, and the diced chicken meat
Let it stand for 5 more minutes
Serve immediately, scattered with cheese, as an appetizer or evening dish on a round plate
Instead of chicken broth, the rice can be cooked with goose broth and diced goose meat added

title: Roastbraten (Braised Beef)
description: Prepared with beef, lard or fat, and onion.

ingredients.name: A well-aged beef roast of about 3 kilos
ingredients.sourceText: A well-aged beef roast of about 3 kilos

ingredients.name: 5 grains of mixed spices of every kind
ingredients.sourceText: 5 grains of mixed spices of every kind

ingredients.name: 16 pieces black bread cut into pieces
ingredients.sourceText: 16 pieces black bread cut into pieces

ingredients.name: Optional: vinegar and soup to taste
ingredients.sourceText: Optional: vinegar and soup to taste

steps: Beat the beef with the flat of the meat cleaver, then wipe clean with a cloth and rub with salt and pepper
In a casserole or pan, place 4 tablespoons lard, 4 pieces finely cut onion, root vegetables, 4 bunches marjoram, 5 crushed juniper berries, 5 grains of mixed spices and 3 pieces dried figs
Place the meat on top, sprinkle finely cut onion over it, pour 4 tablespoons lard over it and cover with paper brushed with lard
Let the meat stand in a cool place for about 2 hours if time permits, then place in the oven and braise covered for 1 hour, occasionally basting
Remove the fat, add {{source-9}}, {{source-10}} and 16 pieces of black bread cut into pieces, and let the meat braise for another about 2 hours
Remove from the pan, strain the well-defatted sauce into a casserole and add vinegar and soup if needed to adjust the taste, bring to a boil and let stand warm
The meat must roast uncovered in the oven for about 1/2 hour more to develop a crust
When serving, slice as desired and garnish with rice, macaroni or similar; serve the sauce in a sauceboat

title: Roasted Apples (Pommes röties)
description: Prepared with apples and powdered sugar.
steps: Wipe the Muskät apples with a cloth
Insert a small corer at the side of the stem
Twist slightly and draw out the core housing without piercing the apples, so that about two knife-backs of the bottom remain
Fill the hollow space created with finely powdered sugar
Place the apples in a flat, dry pan
Roast in the oven without any additional liquid
When the apples feel soft, arrange them heaped on a platter
Pour the thick juice created by roasting over them
Serve with various dishes or also for tea
In this way not only Muskät apples, but any variety of apple can be roasted
Particularly recommended for invalids

title: Roasted Calf's Brain, Grilled (Cervelle de veau grillée)
description: Prepared with calf's brain, breadcrumbs, and stock.
steps: Soak the calf's brain in cold water for several minutes, then peel it
Place 3 tablespoons butter in a casserole and heat it
Add the peeled brain and sprinkle with necessary salt on top
Knead 3 tablespoons butter with {{source-4}} and, if desired, some lemon juice, and place on the brain

Using a serving spoon, place the brain on a dish and pour the sauce, which has been mixed with 1 spoon of soup stock, from the side
Garnish with lemon slices

title: Roasted Lettuce Salad (Laitues farcies)
description: Prepared with lettuce, forcemeat, and broth.
steps: Wash eight whole lettuce heads, place them in boiling salt water for a few minutes, then in cold water, and lay them out on a cloth; once the water has drained sufficiently, separate the leaves and place a spoonful of forcemeat in the center of each head.
Close the leaves and restore the heads to their original form.
In 8 drams hot butter, toast some finely cut fresh parsley, place the lettuce heads in it, pour ½ liter broth over them, and cook uncovered for about ½ hour.
When serving, remove them with a slotted spoon and pour a little butter sauce over the salad.

title: Roasted Poularde (Poularde rötie)
description: Prepared with bacon.
steps: After plucking, flambe the poularde and hold the feet especially in the flame so the scaly skin can be removed
The wings can be cut off entirely or the feathers removed from them
Open the poularde, clean it in cold water, dry it inside and out, and truss it like a pheasant
Lard the breast with fine bacon or cover with bacon slices
Wrap the poularde with a sheet of paper brushed with butter and bind with twine
Put the poularde on a spit and roast it at moderate heat for approximately 3/4 to 1 hour
Remove the paper and roast the poularde over bright fire for another 1/4 hour so it becomes a beautiful brown color
Remove it, cut the twine, pull it out, cut the poularde into desired pieces, arrange them in a bowl, cover with bacon slices and pour the defatted juice over it
Alternatively, the poularde can be placed in a pan with fat and roasted in the oven, basting frequently with its own juice

title: Roggenbrot (Rye Bread)
description: A bread preparation made with rye flour, caraway or anise or fennel or coriander seeds, and water.

ingredients.name: caraway, anise, fennel, or coriander seeds (whole or crushed)
ingredients.sourceText: caraway, anise, fennel, or coriander seeds (whole or crushed)

steps: First, the so-called sponge must be set: Put 3 kilo rye flour in a large suitable vessel (such as a large bowl, wooden trough or small bread trough) and place it in a warm location several hours earlier
Dilute {{source-1}} with {{source-2}} and pour this into the flour in the middle of which a well has been made
Mix in enough flour so that this sponge becomes thick, dust it with some flour, cover it and let it stand overnight after setting it up in the evening
The next day, mix the necessary salt with caraway or anise, fennel or also coriander, whole or crushed, into the sponge
Work this with the flour and the required lukewarm water into a stiff dough for as long as it is fine, that is, knead the dough with both hands until it pulls away from them
Once this is achieved, place it covered near the warm stove and let it ferment

title: Rohmehl Knödel von Semmeltein (Semolina Knödel)
description: Prepared with semolina, egg yolks, and bread crumbs.

ingredients.name: 10 hectograms decrustred semolina bread soaked in milk
ingredients.sourceText: 10 hectograms decrustred semolina bread soaked in milk

steps: Beat 6 hectograms butter until fluffy
Gradually add 2 whole eggs and 2 egg yolks
Mix with 10 hectograms decrustred semolina bread soaked and squeezed dry, {{source-4}}, and {{source-5}}

Distribute the dough evenly over it and place the noodles in boiling salted water
Cook covered for 15 minutes, stirring the bottom occasionally with a wooden spoon so the noodles do not stick
After 15 minutes, remove with a slotted spoon

title: Rolladen mit Champignons (Veal Rolls with Mushrooms)
description: A bread preparation made with veal, mushrooms, and bacon.

ingredients.name: half coffee cup of white wine
ingredients.sourceText: half coffee cup of white wine

steps: Cut fine schnitzels from a veal leg, pound them well; then take some leftover roast, a small piece of bacon, some marrow, a piece of cooked ham, green parsley, chives, some truffles, chop all this finely together
Mix salt, pepper, 2 egg yolks, and 2 spoonfuls of cream well together, spread this on the mentioned schnitzels, and roll them together

In a casserole, lay some bacon strips and place the rolls on them, cover with bacon strips, put the lid on the casserole, apply heat from below and above, and let them stew on a gentle charcoal fire for two hours
Strain off the fat, cut the rolls lengthwise, lay them on the dish so that the stuffing is visible
Take small, clean-washed mushrooms, let a piece of butter become hot, add green parsley, chives and the mushrooms, and let them stew until the sauce is completely reduced

Dust some flour on it, and let it stew down a little more; finally add half a coffee cup of white wine, the same amount of broth and 2 spoonfuls of cream, and let it cook until only very little sauce remains
Strain the fat from the sauce well, and pour it over the rolls; with the mushrooms, form a ring around the edge of the dish, and arrange the rolls in the middle of the dish

title: Rolled Egg Dish (Oeufs à la Palestine)
description: Prepared with cherries, eggs, and salt.

ingredients.name: Optional: vegetables, peas, ham, truffles, ragout, Parmesan cheese, other meats, snails, or mushrooms
ingredients.sourceText: Optional: vegetables, peas, ham, truffles, ragout, Parmesan cheese, other meats, snails, or mushrooms

steps: Beat 12 eggs with {{source-1}} until well combined.
Heat {{source-2}} in a sauté pan and pour in a serving spoon of the beaten eggs.
When the egg sheet becomes slightly firm, lift it from the pan with the aid of two serving spoons into a bowl.
Continue with remaining egg mixture, baking successive sheets and removing each to the bowl.

Immediately after baking, each sheet is topped with preserved cherries, the sheets are rolled lightly together, arranged in a bowl, sprinkled with sugar, and placed in the hot oven for a few minutes so the eggs warm through.

Alternatively, instead of cherries, the egg sheets can be filled with fine vegetables, green peas, finely chopped ham, truffles, fine ragout, or grated Parmesan cheese, finely chopped other meats, breaded and fried fish, roasted snails, or finely chopped mushrooms braised in butter.

title: Romaine Lettuce (Kopfsalat)

title: Root Vegetable Broth for Preparing Other Light Broths (Bouillon maigre aux racines)

Strain through sieve into an earthenware pot and set aside for further use

title: Rose Hips in Steam (Hagebutten im Dunst)
description: Prepared with rose hips, water, and sugar.

ingredients.name: Approximately 1 kilo fresh, still hard rose hips
ingredients.sourceText: Approximately 1 kilo fresh, still hard rose hips

steps: Split the rose hips open and remove the down and seeds with a small spoon
Place the rose hips in a warm location for several days so they become soft
In a tin-lined pot, put 1.5 liters water and 80 Deca sugar, let it boil for 15 minutes
Add the rose hips and let them simmer together for several minutes, stirring frequently
Remove the rose hips from the liquid and cook the liquid until somewhat thicker
Fill the rose hips into jars and pour the sugar over them so that it completely covers them
After complete cooling, bind the jars with bladders and proceed further like the Muscatel pears (No. 1842)

title: Rostboeuf garniert (Roasted Beef, Garnished)
description: Prepared with beef, fat, and broth or water.
steps: Remove bones and fat from the meat, season with salt and pepper, and lightly bind if desired.
Heat 15 dg fat in a low pan until very hot, add the meat, sear on all sides over strong heat, place in a hot oven, and continue roasting for 25-30 minutes under frequent basting with its own juices.
Place on a plate and keep warm in the oven.
Make the sauce by pouring off the fat, browning 4 dkg butter in the pan, adding broth or water, bring to a boil, and strain.
Slice the meat very thinly, arrange on a long platter, garnish alternating around with 1 spoon of vegetables and between them 1 small scoop of rice, and decorate with parsley.

ingredients.name: 1 large light turnip and 1 dark yellow turnip
ingredients.sourceText: 1 large light turnip and 1 dark yellow turnip

steps: Peel and cut turnips, potatoes and cabbage thinly; also add onion if desired.
Cut leftover roasted meat into desired pieces.
Line a casserole with butter or goose fat, cover the bottom with raw turnips, lay a portion of the above vegetable mixture on top.
Sprinkle with necessary salt, cayenne pepper or paprika, then add a layer of cut, roasted meat and continue in this manner until the casserole is filled.
Rice should be added last.
Pour 1 liter of broth over all, close the casserole well and braise the contents for 1 hour.
If the rice is not yet soft enough, pour in additional broth as needed.
Turn everything out onto a platter and serve with clear broth.
If desired, strawberry jam or various roasted sausages can be added to the casserole.

title: Russkaia Faschia (Polish-Style Soup)
description: A soup made with groats, eggs, and butter.
steps: In a casserole, add 1/2 liter of groats and 2 whole eggs and stir on a hot plate with a spoon until it is dry.
Add {{source-2}} and {{source-3}} to 1/2 liter of boiling water.
Loosen the groats with this and stir constantly for approximately 3 minutes over strong heat.
Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, coat a ring mold generously with butter, press the groats into it, place it uncovered in the oven where it must bake slowly for 1 hour.
Before serving, turn the groats out onto a platter, pour some hot butter over it and garnish it like the Kugelhupf with bratwurst and fried goose liver.
Serve very hearty brown broth or sauerkraut soup with it.

title: Salamiwurst (Salami Sausage)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and pork.
steps: Remove all skin and connective tissue from the 5 pounds lean beef, 3 pounds bacon, and 3 pounds pork
Chop the meat very finely, the bacon somewhat more coarsely
Mix well together and let stand unsalted for 24 hours
Mix 10 to 11 Loth salt, 3 Loth cardamom, and 4 Loth ground pepper well into the chopped meat
Fill the mixture firmly into wide casings and tie well
Pierce the casings all around with needles
Hang in an air chimney or on an air loft, which should usually be done in a winter month
After hanging for 14 to 15 days, they can be stored for further use in a cool place

ingredients.name: 1 skinned hare back with both skinned haunches
ingredients.sourceText: 1 skinned hare back with both skinned haunches

steps: Place the hare back and haunches in a casserole with finely cut bacon and onion
Roast, pour over with some red wine and broth
Cook covered until tender
Remove the back and haunches, place on a board, and carefully bone the meat
Place the meat on a dish and cover with buttered paper so it forms a crust
Put the hare forelegs with the bones from back and haunches into the broth
Add 5 juniper berries and 5 pieces each of various spices
Cook covered until meat is tender
Add 1 cleaned goose liver and cook together covered for ½ hour
Strain the remaining broth
Pound the remainder finely in mortar and pass through sieve
Strain and stir well together
If the purée is thinner than needed, dilute with some of the broth
Place this purée (called Salmis) in a dish and set on ice
When serving, place finger-high finely chopped aspic in a dish
Add a portion of Salmis on top
Arrange pieces of back and haunches on this
Continue layering Salmis and meat until all is used
When arranged in a raised dome with Salmis as the final layer, smooth with a knife dipped in hot water and cover the surface with a piece of aspic down to the dish edge

title: Salpicon (Salpicon Ragout)
description: Prepared with beef, crayfish, and truffles.
steps: Cook the ox palate, rooster combs and beef sweetbreads until tender in a good braise
Let cool
Cut into small dice, as well as the crayfish tails, truffles, mushrooms, and cucumbers or small capers
Sauté in butter
Dust with one tablespoon of flour
Add coulis or white sauce and let simmer briefly
Add some cooked smoked tongue
Season well
Bind with egg yolk and some lemon juice
Can also use leftover poultry
Fill into cream cups
Sprinkle fine brown breadcrumbs on top
Place a little crayfish butter on top
Allow to brown in a lukewarm oven
This ragout can be used for various dishes

title: Salsify (Oyster Plant)
description: Prepared with salsify, vinegar, and broth.
steps: These roots must be scrubbed very quickly, as they lose their color and turn red through prolonged handling in the hand; to prevent this, put some flour with water in a bowl, stir it well, add some vinegar and warm water, and as soon as a root is scrubbed, place it immediately in this mixture.

In 8 ounces of hot butter, let an equal amount of flour roast, then pour it with good broth, add the roots cut into desired pieces (which have been removed from the scrubbing solution and rinsed with fresh water), and let them cook gently with the necessary salt.
